Creative Analytics Digest (last week): We reviewed 40 ads across 2 objective segments.

Sales (Catalog):  
What won: Gold and brown colors led the pack, outperforming the Sales (Catalog) average by about 90% on performance index. Yellow and red colors also did well, beating benchmarks by 42% and 25% respectively. Static pacing showed steady results, exceeding average performance by 8%.  
What lost: Black and green colors underperformed, trailing the benchmark by 17% and 27%. Ads with urgency hooks and discount offers fell short by roughly 33%.  
Cross-crystal highlight: No strong cross-crystal combos identified.  
Ads to scale: 6884038808713, 6954576671113, 6961257516313, 6917581764313, 6909058527913  
Ads to watch: 6960790422713, 6917581764113, 6873186272313, 52506432677117

Sales:  
What won: Billboard advertisement visuals crushed the benchmark, beating Sales average by 83%. Product showcase visuals and ads with benefit-led hooks also excelled, outperforming by 64%. Orange colors and upbeat music boosted results by over 70%.  
What lost: Cheerful moods and pink colors lagged behind by 21% and 22%. Studio mode and urgency hooks underperformed by about 24%. Sale banner visuals and indoor home environments trailed by 25% and 26%.  
Cross-crystal highlight: Ads combining urgency hooks with discount offers showed a strong 112% performance lift.
